input.sha256_scope: Compact JSON of the sixteen self-authored point lists in capture document order.
input.provenance: Self-authored integer point sets in tools/capture_min_area_box_oracle.py.

expected.sha256_scope: Compact JSON of the sixteen ordered corner lists in capture document order.

limitations: Corner coordinates are compared within 2e-3 because OpenCV evaluates the rectangle in float32 while this implementation uses float64; the recorded values carry only single-precision significance.
It covers cv2.minAreaRect and cv2.boxPoints on sixteen self-authored point sets in the recorded scalar OpenCV 5.0.0 environment, and nothing else.
It does not establish unclipping, scoring, rescaling, detector output, model behaviour, or OCR compatibility.
